title: Effect Summary Legend
summary: The purity analysis writes a short token string for every routine it judges -- symbolfacts.effectsummary in the index
intro: Read this when hover or ask effects shows a short effect string and you need to decode it. Tokens include g (touches global or external state, including SQL), h (frees heap it did not allocate), s (writes its own instance fields) and `p<k>` (writes through parameter k, counted from 0).
